description: Admin-side emailed invitations: list, send, resend, revoke.

not_applicable.filtering: No filter parameters; every invitation is listed.
not_applicable.raw_protocol: Plain JSON request/response; no ranges, redirects, multipart, or upgrades.

scenarios.description: Lists every invitation: 200 JSON array.
Status is derived per row: pending, accepted, expired; the inviter's name is joined.
Optional fields (access_group_id, library_ids, note, accepted_at, accepted_user_id, invited_by_name) are omitted when empty; accepted_at is an RFC3339 string when present.
scenarios.notes: expires_at/created_at are time.Time while accepted_at is a pre-formatted string pointer; mixed timestamp encodings on one object. Flagged for the section PR.

scenarios.description: Newest first by created_at.
An admin without a declared profile passes the acting-admin gate.
An admin acting through a non-primary profile is refused: admin powers need the primary profile.

body.value: Admin access requires the account's primary profile

scenarios.description: A non-admin account is 403 forbidden.
A scoped API key (admin:users) is refused: the scope does not cover invitations.

body.value: API key scopes do not permit this route

scenarios.description: Sending an invitation answers 201 with the invitation, email_sent, and the claim URL.
Without SMTP the invitation is still created (email_sent false) and the claim URL embeds a fresh token under the configured link base; defaults are role user, create_profile true, show_tour true.
With no external_url setting the server PublicURL is the link base.
Re-inviting a pending address revokes the earlier invitation and issues a new one.
A malformed address is 400 invalid_email.
An address with an account is 409 email_taken.

body.value: An account with this email already exists

body.value: You may not grant this role

scenarios.notes: An invalid enum value is 403 rather than 400; flagged for the section PR.
